_description: Config for CT Abdomen and Pelvis party macro conversion. Universal rules (Rules/universal_rules.json) always run first; additionalRules below run after, for exam-specific edits that don't belong everywhere.
name: CT Abdomen and Pelvis

examMatch._note: Verified 2026-08-12 against a real copied CT Abd/Pelvis header ("CT ABDOMEN/PELVIS WITH CONTRAST").

sections._note: extract sections pull from a labeled block in the HARM-templated source text

keywordScan: no separate 'Stones:' label exists in the HARM source, so this scans the Kidneys section's extracted text for stone-related terms. If found, it's flagged in the diff view for manual review rather than auto-written -- move the text into the Stones field yourself in PowerScribe. If not found, the Stones field keeps the template's own default ('No stones.').
impressionBlock: carries the source report's own IMPRESSION text forward into the party template's Impression field, rather than leaving it blank.
